privacy.title: How data is used
privacy.text: Contact form data is used to respond to your enquiry. Seminar registration data is used to organise participation and send the joining link. Do not include confidential information in the forms. Before launch, the organiser must publish a full privacy notice identifying the data controller, retention periods and contact details for requests.
